positions.note: Oracle-verified losing move (walkback, seeds 0/1/2): (6,6) loses 3/3; (11,6) wins 3/3, (10,7) and (11,9) draw 3/3. v11's own search KNOWS (6,6) is bad (q=-0.105, 30 visits) vs (11,6) (q=+0.024, 4 visits) but most-visited picks (6,6) — the q-vs-visits gap (iter-7 §2.6), batch-4 H1's territory. The net's leaf values are near-neutral here (+0.022 vs 0.000 for White), so no H3-scope leaf patch fixes it. xfail: open weakness, H1's target. See iter-11.md §5.1.
